prompt: Redesign this simple game asset into a realistic, beautiful ancient jungle temple gate while keeping exactly the same overall shape and proportions: two thick square stone pillars standing apart with a wide open walkway between them, and a heavy stone lintel resting on top with a second slightly narrower stone block above it.
